# A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A26′ — The Essay Inside the Film](conjugate/A26-prime-The-Essay-Inside-the-Film.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

**Objective Internality is the means through which a Life knows and acts within a World.** Subjective Immediacy is the knower, pramātṛ; Objective Internality is pramāṇa; World is the known, prameya; Life / Mind is the whole relation. The title’s “Mind as Worldhood” names this mediating mind-world. Mind in the strong idealist and psychic-facticity senses is the living whole; Objective Internality is the articulated means within that whole through which a world becomes available. Language, memory, valuation, bodies, institutions and tools are effective constituents of the means; the means is lived and situated before any investigator makes a record of it.

Objective Internality means **Mind as Worldhood**. Remembering, perceiving, judging and acting occur through a situated context-world. Language, bodies, tools, other people, material support and inherited rules participate in its constitution: changing them changes what can appear, matter and be done. Their relation to the operative interior is therefore stronger than an influence arriving at a finished mind from outside.

A [world-picture](A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) represents a world which continues to condition how that representation can be understood and used. A [received mediating office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) gives finite agency its positions and permissions. These conditions become internal to an operation without becoming spatially enclosed in an operator. [Internality](concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) is constitutive in this sense: a context-world takes form through its effective relations and the achieved act returns as an inheritance.

## #1

The constitutive triad is **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

The [abstraction/experience relation](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#experience-and-constructive-continuation) is active within this worldhood. An inspectable permission can be recorded while also determining which actions become possible; its place in the operative world exceeds the record considered alone. This is precisely the constitutive point: a rule or mark may be inspectable as an object and simultaneously participate in the world from which later action becomes possible.


A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

[Worldhood](concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) gives a field within which something can appear and matter; a [context frame](concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) selects a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. An inspectable [judgment field](concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) relates the model, its sources and the judgment it enables. The bounded model has a genuine object, while the world which lets the model operate continues beyond its boundary.

## #2

The subject/object dyad becomes more exact when the [means of knowing](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) are retained. Pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya differentiates the subject-pole, mediation and known field. A perception, a memory or an articulated inference is objectively investigable. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

A [bounded subject-position](concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) has a situated horizon; the [inner instrument](concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) determines, appropriates and coordinates what becomes available there. Investigating this apparatus discloses how a world is organised while retaining the distinction between its objectifiable means and the knower to whom their activity appears. The precise Śaiva and Sāṃkhya classifications remain source-specific: a functional comparison must preserve which account assigns each office.

Knower, means and known also recur within the articulated field. At a local grain an agent occupies the functional knower office of the situation it discriminates. Its model, memory, rules and tools mediate that discrimination; the addressed objects, interlocutors and possible actions form its known field. The [native theorem](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) writes every compressed knowing relation through these offices and develops reserve, instance, active context, performed pattern, wider lamination and return in its agentic crosswalk. The relation has a centre of activity without requiring that centre to contain the whole field in which it acts.

A route planner makes the relative offices concrete. The planner discriminates candidate paths through a map, a routing rule and access information. It is the local functional knower; those resources are its means; the paths and conditions it differentiates are known. In the person's journey, that planner belongs among the means by which a destination becomes reachable. A report of a locked gate can then become known to the planner and expose a condition in its means: stale information, an access permission or a criterion which failed to receive the person's situation. The next route changes when the returned difference reaches the relevant source, rule or commission. The same component can thus be knower in a local operation and means within its containing Life/World relation.

Inspection brings that local centre itself into the known field of a further inquiry. Performed selfhood, memory and self-description can be real operations of the centre while becoming objects of account at this further grain. Life / Mind holds these nested relations. Subjective Immediacy names the first-person condition in which their appearing is given; collecting more descriptions does not make that condition another described component. The distinction preserves both the agent's effective epistemic position and the lived knower's irreducible office. Technical inquiry can investigate the local centre, its mediating world, the differences it makes and the return that changes its next act, while keeping the containing relation available through what it discloses.

## #3

The [recognition sequence](conjugate/AC.md) makes the means reflexively available: `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1`. An inner instrument can identify its own determining activity with the Subject and present its discriminations as self-standing objects. Recognition makes that activity available as medium, then makes the related recognitions on both sides available together. The instrument is not discarded; its claim to exhaust knower or World changes. Within the [inner instrument](concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md), buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates and manas coordinates; the [means of knowing](concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) remain distinguishable by their warrants. The sixfold, eight determinations and recognition sequence remain related but distinct.

Taylor's [Symbolon Dynamics](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) develops two temporal views of that world. Synchronically, memory, affect, language, expectations, tools, permissions and collaborators constrain one another as a present landscape. Diachronically, the agent follows a trajectory through those constraints and changes them by acting. A new memory, damaged trust or altered permission changes which trajectories become available next.

The phase-space is a mathematical image of possible configurations and trajectories. It is not the world substituted for its image. In [Symbolon Dynamics](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md), a finite intelligence participates in a world which its activity helps transform. Symbolic interpretation and mathematical modelling have distinct consequences here: lived meaning can reorganise the encountered world, while a trajectory model can compare specified configurations and transitions under its declared conditions.

Frank's protected Watson encounter adds the sequence **Discontinuity → Objective Internality → Harness elements → Objective Immortality**. Produced forms can outlast the act which produced them and become conditions of a later encounter. A retained judgment, commitment or tool arrangement supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous acts. “Objective immortality” names this returned availability: an achieved form becomes objective for what follows and can participate in constituting the next interior. The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness|Watson source house]] preserves the encounter through which this sequence was developed.

The same encounter's theatre image preserves a relation a container metaphor loses. The visible actor, the staged position and the contextual activity which lets a scene occur have different offices. An account of the actor alone leaves the enacted world unexplained. The image figures operative context; its quoted historical formulations remain verification leads in the notes.

## #4

In Bratton's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active context]], an agent individuates in session from a potentiality which does not already contain that individual as a hidden occupant. Its [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017|layered constitution]] makes persona one stratum among modular skills, memory, constraints and relations. These venue propositions sharpen the argument's account of active context: an agent is not a hidden occupant subsequently placed inside a finished container, but an individuation arising through layered capacities, constraints, memory and relation.

The technical consequence is to make epistemics part of what can be examined. Prompt, retrieved source, memory, permission, evaluator and organisational role must remain distinguishable from the answer they helped produce. Their change can then be related to a change in judgment or action. [Computational Vimarśa](concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) returns an inspectable finding to the operative condition it can warrantably revise; [Prompt Thrownness](concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) receives the encounter with an already-given situation. Self-description is one datum within this account and does not certify the whole causal process it describes.

A governed reference map can serve as the local original against which judgments are compared. Relative to its wider source-world, that map is itself a constructed determination. This recursive Bimba office prevents a useful reference field from becoming a claim to possess the world. [Authored ground](A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) retains the source and commission through situated delegation. [Objective co-internality](A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) lets worlds meet through actual returned differences without one becoming mere context for another.

## #5→0

The product field returns six aspects of these means to their Life/World whole: carried meaning through Central; articulated event through Actuation; available and developing potency through AIKit; tested transformation through Software Factory; situated encounter through Workcell; relation to containing wholes through Quaternal Logic. The [Life/World relation](conjugate/AC.md) holds these aspects together in the product-led development of Objective Internality. Their full paired-MEF meanings give the notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted account differentiated technological consequences. Each product must retain whose meaning a reference addresses and what an actual encounter returns.


Taylor's Mystic Writing Pad comparison joins clearing, persistence of traces and later shaping. An apparently empty present surface need not have lost the history which conditions what next appears. [Revisable intention and frozen script](A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) diverge here: the inherited disposition can receive what the new inscription exposes or can force it through a fixed rule. The image matters because clearing does not erase every trace of what conditioned the next inscription; its exact attribution to Freud depends on the actual passage.

An achieved act changes [the field of later availability](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md). Bergson’s melody makes this pressure qualitative: a new note alters the heard phrase as a whole. In the technical register, a corrected source, retained memory or changed permission can instead be inspected as a changed condition of subsequent judgment. The [process-science comparison](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT-process-systems-science.md) keeps Bergson’s lived duration distinct from Whitehead’s account of an occasion becoming objectively available beyond its own formation. This historical distinction sharpens the constitutive office of worldhood: what becomes objectively available after an act can alter the conditions of what follows without being identical to the act that produced it.

In the [undated Bohm dialogue handout](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md), an inherited assumption’s activity becomes available for inspection. Memory, affect and a tacit role can condition what is heard before a conclusion is defended. Suspension retains the assumption without immediate enactment or suppression, allowing a changed relation to enter the next act. The 1996 book remains a distinct source object. This practice acts within worldhood: the assumption participates in how the next encounter becomes available, and its disclosed activity can cease to govern that encounter in the same way.

In [the dream](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream), an experienced world can be effective while its objects need not be externally material. Waking changes their source relation without cancelling the experienced urgency. A model relay has a different office: action based on a simulation's result changes the situation which a later model receives. Their conjunction preserves the difference between experienced worldhood and a technical causal record while showing that both can be internally real and consequential within the world they help constitute.

In Taylor’s [centre-everywhere image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere), each real local centre opens a world within recursively nested internalities. A local world opens within relations which also appear from other centres, and a further reflection can enter those worlds without replacing their reality. This return preserves the real recursive Bimba relation: a produced reference map remains a reflection and does not acquire the originary office merely because it organises a later view. The image supplies no external spectator or final enclosing circumference, and its historical formula remains a distinct attribution task.

In [Indra’s jewel net](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence), a selected jewel reflects the others while its own brightness depends on their constitutive participation. What appears in the selected jewel depends on a relation already active among jewels; adding further reflected contents cannot put the representation outside that dependence. The image supplies a Huayan comparison for a relation in which the local reflection is constituted through a field it cannot gather into itself.

In [the travelling jigsaw](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-native-and-archetypal-field), a completed local fit encounters conditions which its prior picture did not contain. The frame selects what can count as a fit, while the traveller encounters conditions beyond that selection. Recording more context remains useful within this dependence; it does not make the resulting atlas the whole condition of appearing.

[The Village](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) constitutes Six's operative world through signs, permissions, rules and exclusions. Its rooms, neighbours and possible routes change what Six can know and do. His reply tests whether the returning account can change those conditions of encounter; the administered setting makes its rooms, neighbours and routes part of the political contest over his answer.

The emerging centre and its distinguishable world form through one relation of differentiation. Taylor's [archetypal articulation](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) gives this relation a mythemic body; the technical formation requires an actual comparison at its own scale. Intake, response and durable result return as conditions of the operative interior; its boundaries remain effective through that wider field. The [uroboros return](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return) makes the achieved result available to the capacity from which another act can begin.

The result returns as part of the world of the next act. A corrected permission changes possible action; a remembered objection changes what an instruction means; another participant's response changes the account through which they were approached. Objective Internality makes this continuity inspectable without requiring every act to be performed by one permanent operator.

Within the [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account relation]], an encounter becomes addressable and reckonable within a region; the resulting account returns to participants who can change it. These operations give the relation its precision, while common lexical ancestry requires a separate historical warrant. [The Other](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) remains present beyond what an account can exhaust. [Deferential encounter](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) lets their returned difference reach the model, source or criterion at the depth the encounter actually warrants.

A [world-model](A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) is useful through the world-relations it preserves and the changes it makes possible. In [Agentworld](concepts/C57-Agentworld.md), the assembled agent receives that consequence through its sources, tools, permissions and relations: changes there can change what it knows and does next. The constitutive claim remains broader than its technical instance.
